✦ Make a math facts game

Generate answers and matching clues. Equivalent facts share one answer square; a fresh clue is chosen each round.

Use numbers from 0–20. Subtraction stays nonnegative. Division uses these factors to make whole-number answers (e.g. 6 × 8 becomes 48 ÷ 8).
